name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action. (Modelled: base AC 13 + Dex for 8 hours; the not-wearing-armor requirement, ending on donning armor and dismissal are not checked.)
